finalText:
Found it: `orderTotal` was taxing the pre-discount amount and adding it to the separately-rounded discounted price, instead of taxing the discounted amount. That double-rounding mismatch only showed up on rows with both a discount and a tax.

Fixed in `src/pricing.js` — now discounts first, then taxes the discounted total. All 625 tests pass, and `verify.js` confirms it.
